angleRead.text: I will write about the lives of nine people in C114, focusing on the significant events that happened to them. I'll start with Alexa Ward, who moved into a place of their own in West Oakland. I'll explore the details of their life, including the fact that they spent too long in a bookstore aisle they'd never stopped at. I'll then move on to the other eight individuals, weaving their stories together into a cohesive narrative. I'll make sure to conclude directly on the last person's passage, avoiding a summary paragraph.
